API Reference¶

Diagram¶

class bpmn_py.Diagram(name: str)¶

Bases: object

Represents a BPMN process diagram.

Parameters:

name – Name of the BPMN diagram.

add_event(label: str, type: event_type, element_id: str = None)¶

Add an event to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • label – The name of the event.

  • type – BPMN event type.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created Event object.

add_gateway(label: str, type: gateway_type, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a gateway to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • label – The name of the gateway.

  • type – BPMN gateway type.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created Gateway object.

add_message_flow(startRef: str, endRef: str, label: str = None, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a message flow to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • startRef – The element ID of the BPMN element the flow starts from.

  • endRef – The elemnent ID of the BPMN element the flow ends at.

  • label – The name of the message flow.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created MessageFlow object.

add_pool(label: str, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a pool to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • label – The name of the pool.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created Pool object.

add_sequence_flow(startRef: str, endRef: str, label: str = None, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a sequence flow to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • startRef – The element ID of the BPMN element the flow starts from.

  • endRef – The elemnent ID of the BPMN element the flow ends at.

  • label – The name of the sequence flow.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created SequenceFlow object.

add_swimlane(label: str, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a swimlane to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • label – The name of the swimlane.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created Swimlane object.

add_task(label: str, type: task_type, element_id: str = None)¶

Add a task to the BPMN diagram.

Parameters:

  • label – The name of the task.

  • type – BPMN task type.

  • element_id – Optional BPMN element ID. If omitted, an ID is generated automatically.

Returns:

The newly created Task object.

print_elements()¶

Print all the elements in the BPMN diagram.

BPMN Parser¶

class bpmn_py.BPMNParser(file_path)¶

Bases: object

Parses a BPMN xml file.

Parameters:

name – The filepath of the .bpmn file.

parse() → Diagram¶

Parse the .bpmn file and create a BPMN Diagram from it.

Returns:

The newly created Diagram object.

BPMN Exporter¶

class bpmn_py.BPMNExporter(diagram: Diagram)¶

Bases: object

Exports a BPMN Diagram object to pddl.

Parameters:

diagram – The diagram object you wish to export.

create_pddl()¶

Create the corresponding pddl for the diagram.

XML Creator¶

create_xml()¶

Create the corresponding xml for the diagram.
